pages.text: The express: eight blocks long, 58 km/h, nearly twice as strong as the tank engine.

The express carries no coal or water itself: couple a $(item)Tender$() to it (at either end) and it uses the tender's. A tender holds 128 coal's worth and 64 buckets of water, and its coal heap goes down as it's used.$(br2)Click the engine or the tender with fuel to fill the tender. Without one the express won't go: its gauges say NO TENDER.

Hoppers and wagon loaders fill tenders too, with fuel only, so a train on a timetable can take on coal at a station with a $(l:freight/wagon_loader)wagon loader$(/l). Click the tender empty-handed to see how full it is.
The tender: coal at the front, the water tank behind.
